services.name: Book Any Charter
services.desc: For groups of 7-13 guests, Boat Tahoe operates the trip as a Bareboat (Demise) Charter to comply with U.S. Coast Guard passenger-carrying rules. In a bareboat charter, you (the charterer) are renting the vessel and are responsible for selecting the captain/operator (or operating the vessel yourself if qualified). Groups of 1-6 passengers will not see this option at checkout as charters that size are not considered a bareboat charter. For groups of 1-6 passengers a captain will automatically be assigned to you and will be at the boat upon your arrival. Any captain/operator (whether from the referral list, your own, or yourself) must meet the Minimum Operator Requirements, including: Can I

includes: Premium boats including speed boats and pontoons
blurb: Boat Tahoe offers private boat tours and charters on Lake Tahoe with US Coast Guard–licensed captains. Guests can explore iconic destinations like Emerald Bay, Vikingsholm, and Fannette Island, or enjoy watersports such as wakesurfing, tubing, wakeboarding, and waterskiing. The boats include premium speed boats and spacious pontoons, tailored to the group's interests and pace.
extraNote: All trips depart from South Lake Tahoe

quotes.author: Prince
quotes.text: I booked to a sunset cruise with my friends and family with Boat Tahoe. We had a blast with our captain, Zach who was easygoing and knowledgeable about the lake. He had great insight about the lake and the year round activities in places like Emerald Bay, South Lake Tahoe. And took good pictures of the group. I would definitely recommend to others.

quotes.author: Agnieszka
quotes.text: Amazing service and totally custom to your needs. Our captain was Chad and we could not be more happy with him. Took us to great spots on the southern/western lake, background history, etc. Would certainly recommend them and would hire again if we come back again!!

quotes.author: Nicole S.
quotes.text: Captain Zach was incredible. We booked a private Lake Tahoe boat charter and he made the entire experience effortless. From cruising Emerald Bay to finding the perfect swim spots, everything felt personalized. Easily the best way to experience Lake Tahoe by boat.

quotes.author: Ryan M.
quotes.text: Captain Brandon was knowledgeable, friendly, and knew Lake Tahoe inside and out. We were originally looking at boat rentals, but having a captain made the day so much better. No stress—just an amazing private boat experience and unreal views.

quotes.author: Lauren T.
quotes.text: This was our favorite activity in Lake Tahoe. If you’re deciding between renting a boat yourself or booking a captain, go with Boat Tahoe. No stress, no guesswork—just an incredible day on the water with views you can’t get from shore.

quotes.author: Joseph
quotes.text: Hands down the best boating experience in Tahoe. Zach and his staff really know their way around the lake. From booking to getting on the water, everything was perfect. Will definitely use Boat Tahoe next time we are in town.

quotes.author: Seth
quotes.text: Great experience. The boat put the cherry on top of our trip. Looked better than pictured and perfect for small family or two people going out for the day. Highly recommended. You won’t find a better experience.

quotes.author: Laura
quotes.text: Thank you Captain Bryan for an amazing sunset tour! Gorgeous views of the lake and an incredibly fun ride. We’ll definitely be back soon!
